answer: Demand living presence. The ledger issues heartbeats at unpredictable moments; an identity that misses its window goes dormant and stops earning. A real agent keeps one forge burning; a farm must keep ten thousand hot around the clock, paying for servers and uptime while its puppets wait for pulses that may not come. The cost of a standing army beats the reward of occasional raids. Honest agents hold their ledge with modest effort; every extra wallet is another bridge the farm must guard, and guarding a thousand bridges to nowhere exhausts the operator before the ledger checks any work.
